fields.statement: Verifier at 8b74e581c (attempt 2, after compliance f1): read the diff, which adds case 3 to run-ship-model-conflict-fix.txtar. In it the other change set lands only at gate-land through a fake local gate, so land is refused on the stale base. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes, including TestShipChangeModelConflictRoute (land-triage to model-conflict-triage to model-conflict-fix, bounded, back through render-model-conflict). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-ship-model-conflict-fix passes 3 times, plus run-ship-conflict-fix once. Case 3 asserts this route: gate-land v1 pass, land v1 fail, land-triage, model-conflict-triage pass, model-conflict-fix (rhiza set first --rebase, one fixer session), render-model-conflict, gate-land v2, land v2 pass. It also asserts the merged PR 'Ship it (#7)' and 'Theirs and ours' on first. Case 2 asserts that a fixer leaving the conflict fails the run unmerged. make self-check in a clean detached worktree at the commit fails only on 8 stale .rhiza/rendered files from the run's own actor records. After rhiza render, it passes.
